items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: He was a young man I met when I first came down here. He wasn't in music at all.

ctx.x: He was a young man I met when I first came down here. He wasn't in music at all.
Yeah. Oh, and they had the Society of Theater Organists. I noticed that in the Union book, they're always talking about S-T-O, and your husband was a member of that.
